basis.quote:
The National Forest hereby created shall be known as the McClellan National
Forest.

The Executive Order dated December 22, 1924, (No. 4114) establishing the McClellan National Forest, Alabama, pursuant to the provisions of Section 9 of the Act of Congress approved June 7, 1924, (43 Stat., 655) on a portion of the Camp McClellan Military Reservation, Alabama, is hereby revoked.
basis.role: ending basis: EO 4877 (May 4, 1928) revokes this order by number, date and subject

proposed_intervals.scope: whole order (establishment of McClellan National Forest from part of Camp McClellan)
proposed_intervals.end_basis: revoked by EO 4877, May 4, 1928 ('is hereby revoked'); inclusive/exclusive reading immaterial to 2026-10-14

searches_run: cruden.py literal 'McClellan National Forest': 8 matches in 6 files; EO 4877 held in ProQuest OCR (pinakes-proquest-ingest EO_4877.txt) and three pinakes-htr readings (tess300, vlm_chandra, vlm_qwen3) with the same wording
material_gaps: No page images of EO 4877 or EO 4114 inspected (text layers/VLM transcriptions only); the ProQuest OCR layer of EO 4877 is noisy, the quoted VLM reading agrees with the qwen3 reading and tesseract fragments
rationale: EO 4114 (Coolidge, 22 Dec 1924, [No. 4114]) established the McClellan National Forest from the Camp McClellan Military Reservation. A held later order, EO 4877 of 4 May 1928 (Coolidge, [No. 4877]), names it by number and date and says it 'is hereby revoked', so the whole order ended 1928-05-04, long before 2026-10-14. EO 4877 has no partial revocation or savings clause.
